clue.text: Announced useful senior player's. joining contest

clue.text: Studio apartment's first rise in rent? That's right

clue.text: Pressure is mounting for foreign character

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Decide whether to return cut of meat

clue.text: Expression of support

clue.text: Speed, offering trip

clue.text: Spring in southern Pennsylvania
